title: All-in-One Frameworks, Link Analysis & Global Situational Dashboards
description: Multi-source OSINT automation engines, entity-relationship graph visualizers, reconnaissance orchestrators, and real-time multi-domain situational awareness platforms.
opsec_notes: Automated frameworks like SpiderFoot, BBOT, and Recon-ng bundle both passive API queries and active HTTP/DNS probes. Always enforce passive-only presets when target alerting is unacceptable.

title: Username Enumeration & Digital Footprint Mapping
description: Cross-platform handle discovery engines, profile metadata extractors, and account correlation datasets spanning 500 to 6,000+ social networks, forums, and developer platforms.
opsec_notes: Username scanners generate high-volume HTTP requests from your IP to hundreds of platforms; route scans through a VPN/Tor or residential proxy pool and manually verify hits to rule out handle collisions.

title: Email Intelligence, Account Enumeration & Corporate Address Discovery
description: Account registration checkers (password-reset/OAuth side-channels), Google workspace/GAIA profilers, corporate email pattern harvesters, reputation scorers, and SMTP/MX verifiers.
opsec_notes: Some password-reset enumeration modules can trigger 'password reset requested' emails or SMS alerts on poorly designed websites. Stick to silent registration-check tools (e.g., Holehe passive modules, Epieos, GHunt) for covert work.

title: Phone Number, Carrier & Messaging App Intelligence (Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp)
description: HLR/CNAM/carrier lookup frameworks, phone-to-account enumerators, and deep intelligence toolkits for Telegram channels/groups, Discord snowflake IDs/servers, and WhatsApp profiles.
opsec_notes: Syncing a target phone number in messaging apps via an investigator phone can expose your sock-puppet contact card if mutual-contact settings are misconfigured. Disable contact sync or use isolated virtual Android environments.

title: People Search, Public Records, Voter, Court & Genealogy Databases
description: Identity resolution engines, federal and state court dockets, voter/property registries, genealogy archives, missing-persons toolkits, and international wanted/interpol notices.
opsec_notes: Public-record portals and commercial people-search aggregators log searcher IP addresses and account sessions; never query sensitive targets from personal networks or non-compartmentalized accounts.

title: Data Breaches, Infostealer Logs, Paste Sites & Leak Archives
description: Historical credential breach indexes, infostealer malware infection telemetry, public whistleblowing document troves, ransomware leak trackers, and paste-site monitors.
opsec_notes: Verify legal authorization in your jurisdiction before downloading or querying raw credential dumps. Prefer metadata/exposure verification APIs (HIBP, Hudson Rock Cavalier, IntelX) over unvetted underground bots.

title: Domain, DNS, Certificate Transparency & Attack Surface Management
description: Passive DNS history, RDAP/WHOIS attribution, Certificate Transparency (CT) log monitors, subdomain enumerators, typosquatting detectors, and web technology profilers.
opsec_notes: Querying Certificate Transparency (`crt.sh`), passive DNS (`SecurityTrails`), and RDAP is 100% passive. Running `httpx`, `Katana`, or DNS brute-forcing touches target servers and leaves logs.

title: Cyberspace Search Engines, IP, ASN, BGP & Internet Telemetry
description: Internet-wide port/banner search engines, exposed IoT/ICS/OT device indexes, BGP/ASN routing analyzers, residential proxy/VPN detectors, and global internet outage monitors.
opsec_notes: Searching Shodan, Censys, FOFA, ZoomEye, Netlas, or GreyNoise queries pre-indexed scan databases and is completely passive with zero packets sent to the target IP.

title: Social Media Intelligence (SOCMINT) — X, Instagram, Reddit, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube
description: Platform-specific collection, deleted-post recovery, social graph mapping, timestamp extraction, location-based post discovery, and cross-platform social listening tools.
opsec_notes: Platforms like LinkedIn, TikTok, and Instagram notify users of profile views or suggest 'People You May Know' if sock puppets share browser fingerprints, IPs, or phone numbers.

title: Source Code, GitHub Recon, Secret Scanning & Multi-Cloud Enumeration
description: Git commit author attribution, leaked API key/secret verifiers, global HTML/JS source code search engines (analytics/adsense ID pivoting), and public AWS/Azure/GCP bucket enumerators.
opsec_notes: Cloning a public GitHub repo is passive, but running live credential verification (`trufflehog` without `--no-verification`) hits third-party APIs and can trigger canarytoken alerts!

title: Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT), Satellite Imagery, Mapping & Chronolocation
description: Multispectral & SAR satellite imagery browsers, Overpass/OpenStreetMap feature query engines, street-level ground-truth archives, solar shadow calculators, terrain skyline matchers, and conflict maps.
opsec_notes: GEOINT platforms are purely passive against real-world targets, though commercial tasking orders on high-resolution constellations may appear in archive catalogs unless private tasking is purchased.

title: Image, Video, Facial Recognition, Audio & Digital Media Forensics (IMINT)
description: Reverse image and facial recognition search engines, EXIF/XMP metadata extractors, Error Level Analysis (ELA) & clone-detection labs, video keyframe verifiers, deepfake detectors, and bioacoustic/audio analyzers.
opsec_notes: Uploading sensitive or unreleased investigation photos to cloud reverse-image or face-search engines (Yandex, PimEyes, VirusTotal-style sandboxes) can cache or index the image; strip borders/EXIF and crop carefully.

title: Aviation, Maritime, Rail, Supply Chain & Vehicle/VIN Intelligence
description: Uncensored ADS-B/MLAT flight trackers, AIS vessel & dark-fleet monitors, GNSS/GPS jamming maps, maritime ownership & port-state control registries, bills-of-lading customs databases, and VIN/plate tools.
opsec_notes: Prefer unfiltered ADS-B networks (`ADS-B Exchange`, `airplanes.live`) when tracking state, military, or LADD-blocked private aircraft censored on commercial flight apps.

title: Corporate Registries, Beneficial Ownership, Sanctions, Trade & Financial OSINT
description: Global company registries, beneficial ownership (PSC/UBO) databases, offshore leak archives, consolidated OFAC/EU/UN/PEP sanctions screens, SEC/procurement filings, and patent/trademark portals.
opsec_notes: Official corporate registries in a few jurisdictions (e.g., certain European/Asian portals) require citizen eID login and log who accessed a company dossier; check registry anonymity rules first.

title: Cryptocurrency, Blockchain Forensics, DeFi & On-Chain Attribution
description: Multi-chain entity attribution platforms, visual transaction flow graphers, UTXO wallet clusterers, AML/OFAC risk screeners, smart-contract/rug analyzers, and ENS/Web3 identity resolvers.
opsec_notes: On-chain queries through public explorers are passive, but never connect a personal Web3 wallet (MetaMask/Phantom) to investigation pages or interact with suspect tokens/airdrops.

title: Dark Web, Tor (.onion), I2P & Ransomware / Underground Monitoring
description: Clearnet-to-Tor `.onion` search engines, darknet crawlers, AI dark-web triage agents, ransomware extortion group trackers, Tor relay telemetry, and PGP keyserver attribution tools.
opsec_notes: Never browse live `.onion` hidden services from a host browser or Tor2Web proxy. Use Tor Browser inside Whonix/Tails or an isolated disposable VM with JavaScript set to Safest.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), Malware Sandboxes, Phishing & IOC Pivoting
description: Multi-engine file/URL scanners, interactive malware sandboxes, Abuse.ch botnet/C2 feeds, JARM/favicon/certificate pivot engines, APT encyclopedias, and STIX/TAXII threat intelligence platforms.
opsec_notes: NEVER upload confidential incident documents or custom adversary implants to public VirusTotal/URLScan/Hybrid Analysis without realizing threat actors monitor public submissions for their own hashes and URLs!

title: Web Archiving, Forensic Evidence Capture, Document Metadata & Grey Literature
description: Historical web caches, tamper-evident forensic browser recorders (WARC/WACZ/SHA-256), headless screenshotters, document metadata extractors, FOIA portals, and academic/scientific search engines.
opsec_notes: Submitting a target's private/unindexed URL to `web.archive.org/save` or `archive.today` causes their crawler to fetch the URL immediately and makes the snapshot publicly discoverable!

title: Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), Wi-Fi/BLE/Cellular Geolocation, SDR & Orbital Space Tracking
description: Global BSSID/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/Cell-tower geolocation databases, browser-accessible HF/VHF Software-Defined Radios (KiwiSDR/WebSDR), orbital TLE satellite trackers, and amateur ground-station networks.
opsec_notes: Querying WiGLE, OpenCelliD, CelesTrak, and KiwiSDR receivers online is passive. Local RF collection with SDR hardware is passive receive-only, but must comply with local telecommunications laws.

title: AI-Powered OSINT Agents, MCP Servers, Browser Extensions & Investigator OPSEC
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) OSINT servers for AI agents, autonomous geolocation & recon skills, context-menu IOC browser extensions, OSINT Linux distributions, and hardened OPSEC/sock-puppet infrastructure.
opsec_notes: When connecting LLM agents to MCP OSINT servers, review whether active/noisy tools are disabled by default (e.g. `OpenOSINT` passive mode) and avoid sending sensitive PII to cloud LLM providers without zero-data-retention.
